$comment: THE source contract. Every Target layout constant lives here once. TypeScript (src/layout/SourceExactLayout.ts) and Python (scripts/v5/source_layout.py) both READ this file; neither keeps its own copy, because two hand-maintained copies drift and the drift is invisible until a gate disagrees. Verified by `npm run v5:target-layout-source`.

target.method: read-only source forensics plus live CSS3D world transforms; no Target code is stored in this repository and nothing was modified or republished

derivation.cols: even(clamp(2 * arcToCover(coverX, planeWidth/2) / cellW + 4, minCols, maxCols))
derivation.rows: even(clamp(2 * arcToCover(coverY, planeHeight/2) / cellH + 4, minRows, maxRows))
derivation.edgeAt: radius*persp*sin(arc/radius)/denom - half*persp/denom, denom = persp + radius*(1 - cos(arc/radius))
derivation.arcToCover: 24-step bisection on edgeAt between 0 and radius*acos(radius/(persp+radius))
derivation.placement: xArc = wrap((col - (cols-1)/2)*cellW + scrollX + (poolRow % 2)*cellW/2, cols*cellW); yArc = wrap(-(poolRow - (rows-1)/2)*cellH - scrollY, rows*cellH); thetaX = xArc/R; thetaY = yArc/R; normal = (sin(thetaX)cos(thetaY), sin(thetaY), cos(thetaX)cos(thetaY)); position = normal*R - (0,0,R); orientation takes local +Z to normal
derivation.initialScroll: (0, 0) at every viewport; the Target's scroll springs are constructed at zero and nothing seeds them
derivation.slotIdentity: ILG code = slotIndex + 1, bound to the POOL SLOT and not to a world cell
